input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x8d680.ticket_themes AS
WITH assigned AS (
 SELECT ticket_id,
 CASE
   WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%charge%' THEN 'Billing'
   WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%access%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%access%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%auth%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%auth%' THEN 'Login and access'
   WHEN lower(subject) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%courier%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%courier%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivered%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivered%' THEN 'Shipping and delivery'
 END AS theme
 FROM workspace.exam_x8d680.tickets
 WHERE (
   lower(subject) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%bill%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%invoice%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%payment%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%charge%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%charge%'
   OR lower(subject) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%login%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%sign in%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%access%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%access%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%password%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%auth%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%auth%'
   OR lower(subject) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%ship%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivery%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%order%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%tracking%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%courier%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%courier%' OR lower(subject) LIKE '%delivered%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%delivered%'
 )
)
SELECT theme, count(*) AS ticket_count, min(ticket_id) AS example_ticket_id
FROM assigned
GROUP BY theme;
